items.item: [iOS-02] Dev machine — Xcode + Flutter SDK + CocoaPods
items.description:
## Intended Outcome
Mac ready for Flutter iOS builds.

## Step-by-Step
1. Install Xcode from Mac App Store (you'll never open it)
2. Accept license: `sudo xcodebuild -license accept`
3. Clone Flutter: `git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable`
4. Add to PATH, `flutter precache --ios`
5. `sudo gem install cocoapods`
6. `flutter doctor`

## Why Xcode?
You never open it. Flutter calls Xcode's toolchain behind the scenes:
- `flutter run` calls Xcode build system automatically
- `flutter build ipa` signs and archives via Xcode tools
- Only time you open Xcode: Organizer > Distribute App (30 secs)
Your workflow stays 100% in Flutter/VS Code.

## Skills/Tools Required
- `flutter-building-layouts` -> `.agents/skills-archive/flutter-building-layouts/SKILL.md`

## Audit (EOD Report-Back)
Append findings to .pi/EOD_AUDIT.md: (1) files changed, (2) verification results, (3) gaps/findings, (4) decisions, (5) estimated tokens.

items.description: Built direct LibreLinkUp API service (bypassing Nightscout). Created librelinkup_service.py with login, graph fetch, sync. Wired into sync_service, cgm.py, users.py, providers.py, db/models.py, models/user.py. Includes connect/disconnect/test/sync endpoints. User Tom Batchelor verified with live data - 47 readings, 60-223 mg/dL range. For local dev use; Nightscout pipeline for production.

items.item: Critical safety features — post-LLM validation + regulatory guardrails
items.description: Implemented Sprint 1 safety features. Created docs/SAFETY.md with FDA/HIPAA regulatory framework. Refactored SafetyAgent to delegate to SafetyScaffold (eliminated duplicate keyword lists). Added disclaimer enforcement to post-LLM check in coordinator.py. Fixed streaming endpoint to check safety before saving/streaming. All 324 tests pass including 30 safety tests. AI acts as diabetic coach with guardrails: no dosing advice, no treatment changes, disclaimer enforced, educational-only responses.

items.description: Create tests that verify detector date range matches simulation window to prevent recurrence of date mismatch bug.

items.description: Execute small cohort validation. Report before/after SQL evidence showing edges created and truths detected.
